text_block_list.name: Teacher
text_block_list.text:
...And those are all the events and
positions for the Spring Fan Fest.
Have a
look at the details and apply for your top
choices by the
deadline!

text_block_list.name: Classmates
text_block_list.text: Okaaay!

text_block_list.name: Classmate A
text_block_list.text:
I wanna go for an event that'll get me tons
of new fans! How about
you? Are you
gonna enter that "race from hell"
everyone's talking
about?

text_block_list.name: Classmate B
text_block_list.text:
No way! I'm more interested in applying
for the Cheer Squad. But
then I wouldn't
be able to compete in the events... Hm...

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: ...Cheer Squad, eh?

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Heh. I know what I must do. The Fan Fest
is a day to behave as my
fans would want
me to.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
It will be the perfect stage for me to give a
grand performance and
prove my first-rate
qualities!

text_block_list.name: Bob-Hair Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Ooh, I'm going to make use of my intellect
and enter the quiz run!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Ah, that's a good choice! You're taking the
opportunity to show off
your speed and
your smarts!

text_block_list.name: Cat-Eyed Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
I-I was thinking of entering the marathon. I
don't know if I'm much of a
marathon
runner, but I want to give it a try.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Great idea! As the name suggests, the Fan
Fest is like a festival, so
it's a good chance
to explore something new with no
pressure!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
I want to make my fans super happy!
Which event should I enter?!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Oh, my! Hehe. Just look at the big picture
and you'll get your answer.
Your fans are
people who have chosen to support you
over countless
other Umamusume.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
So give them a moment that'll make them
glad they chose you.
People like to follow
someone with a firm dream and charisma.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Ah! Waaah! You're the best, King! That
was so helpful!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
I understand now! I'll choose an event that
lets me show off my
dreams and my
charisma to the max!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Speaking of which, which event are you
going to enter?! I'd love to
hear your
thought process!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Naturally, I'll choose an event that allows
me to express my charm to
the fullest. A
challenge that'll make the audience's
palms sweat as I
face up to it!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Though I must say, some of the options
seem a little daunting even
for me.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
The scavenger hunt obstacle race is known
as the "race from hell."
Due to its intense
difficulty, participants have dwindled and
so has its
audience.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Ohhhhh... "Daunting"... "Challenge"...
Which means everyone will be
smitten if
you can complete it!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
A lot of runners give up halfway, so to be
able to entertain the fans
and show off
your skills in this race is a real test of
aptitude.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
It's not the kind of event just anyone can...
Huh? Kawakami?

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: DAAAAAH!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: I will... push... to the maaax!

text_block_list.name: Nearby Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
What? Is Kawakami seriously taking on the
4,000-meter scavenger
hunt obstacle
race? The one everyone drops out of every
year?

text_block_list.name: Nearby Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
Even if she manages it, not many people
will be there to watch. And
hardly
anyone's even entering this year, right?

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: That nincompoop!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Why did you choose that race?! You
should've listened to what I was
going to
say!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Hey, Kawakami! We had a few chocolate
taiyaki left over from
dessert. There's three
up for grabs, so they're doing rock, paper,

scissors for them!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Really?! Let me pla... I mean, I'll pass!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Are you sure? You don't want them? I
thought they were your
favorite.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Ngh... I'm sure! I don't have a second to
spare right now!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Pant, pant... If I overcome this challenge, I'll become a first-rate princess!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: I too... I too...

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Will become first-rate like King! So I can
make my fans glad they
chose to support
me!

text_block_list.name: Bob-Hair Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Wow, Kawakami's still practicing for the
Fan Fest. Well... makes sense
when her
event is so hard to complete.

text_block_list.name: Cat-Eyed Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
She's doing all this practice late into the
night. It'd be sad if no one
came to cheer
for her on the big day.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: ...That nincompoop.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
From what I hear, she's been turning down
her favorite things to
spend all her time on
practice.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
She's even started copying me, calling
herself a first-rate princess.

text_block_list.name: Bob-Hair Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
You know, King, it's tomorrow. The
deadline to hand in your choices
for the
Fan Fest.

text_block_list.name: Cat-Eyed Umamusume
text_block_list.text: Which event are you entering?

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
...The Cheer Squad can't take part in the
competitions. I usually
wouldn't even
consider it.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: But...

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
I am King Halo, now a member of the
Cheer Squad!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
The most appropriate position for me is at
the top, meaning I would
like to be the
leader! To celebrate this meeting, I have
made
costumes for all of you!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Huh? Costumes? What? This is the first
time the Cheer Squad is
meeting, isn't it?

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Yes. But I give everything my absolute
best! Through my connections,
I got us a
custom-made design!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
This year, we have only one goal! To
maximize the fun at every event,
even
those that don't usually receive much
attention.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Our cheers must be worthy of the
competitors giving their all. That's
why...

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
I will put together the most flashy and
unique plan that I possibly can!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Wh-whaaa?!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
(Since a certain fan of mine has chosen
such a difficult challenge...)

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
(The least I can do is cheer her on. After
all, the Fan Fest is an event
for the fans,
isn't it?)
